description: This file defines a scheduled job system for Mattermost plugins, including job scheduling, metadata management, and execution control.

classes.name: JobPluginAPI
classes.description: Interface for plugin API to schedule and manage jobs, including key-value operations.

classes.name: JobConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a scheduled job, primarily its execution interval.

classes.name: NextWaitInterval
classes.description: Function type for calculating the wait time before the next job run.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job with execution logic, metadata, and control channels.

classes.name: JobMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about job execution, notably the last finish time.

methods.name: MakeWaitForInterval
methods.description: Creates a wait interval function based on a fixed interval, scheduling immediately if not previously started.

methods.name: MakeWaitForRoundedInterval
methods.description: Creates a wait interval function that rounds the next run to the nearest interval boundary.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Creates and starts a new scheduled job with specified API, key, interval, and callback.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads job execution metadata from the key-value store.

methods.name: saveMetadata
methods.description: Saves updated job metadata to the key-value store.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for executing the scheduled job, ensuring only one instance runs at a time.
